verdict.rationale: Rippling says it automatically calculates and files payroll taxes with federal, state, and local agencies, and that current and past employees can view tax forms anytime through self-service. That implies year-end forms are produced and made available, but the evidence never names W-2s or 1099s or describes automatic year-end generation or distribution. Missing for 10: explicit W-2 and 1099 generation, contractor 1099 handling, automated year-end distribution workflow (electronic or mail delivery), independent or hands-on corroboration.
